noise.label: illustrative depolarizing channel (ours, not IonQ calibration)

nights.title: The first call
nights.rule: Learn the two tools: Listen finds out who, Trace finds out where.
nights.intel: It's Mira. Tonight she stands evenly between both doors, so either door is right if it's really her.

nights.title: Same voice
nights.rule: The impostor's pattern is closer to Mira's now, and the line will only hold four calls. Choose your dial settings well: Mira's own dial is not always the most telling.
nights.intel: Balanced between both doors, so either door is right if it's her. If it isn't Mira, its line runs a quarter turn (90°) out of step with hers.

nights.title: Two entrances
nights.rule: Tonight the call leans toward one door, and the wrong door lets the cold in. Six calls to split between finding out who and finding out where.
nights.intel: The call leans toward one door (three traces in four would land there). If it isn't Mira, its line runs 135° out of step: three dial steps.

nights.title: The last call
nights.rule: The dying intercom now records the door on every call, so plain listening is gone: the line is a coin flip whoever calls. Erase the record instead: read it sideways (+ or −), then sort your calls by that reading, and her voiceprint comes back in two halves.
nights.intel: It leans toward one door. If it isn't Mira, its line runs a quarter turn (90°) out of step. Erased calls only tell you who after you sort them.
